Theme 010 · Product UI as the stage

Powers-of-Ten Zoom

One continuous dive on an infinite canvas: from 38 dashboards as clouds of dots, into one cluster, one chart, one data point — the single wrong number Acme Pulse found — and all the way back out as every dot turns teal. A zoom pill, breadcrumb and minimap keep the viewer oriented at every altitude.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Dot field — every metric/event as a dot; 38 clusters = 38 dashboards.
  • Cluster labels — checkout, signups, latency… readable only at mid altitude.
  • Nested frames — receding outlines showing how deep we are.
  • Data-point macro — the single coral 09:42 point with its value.
  • Minimap with viewport rectangle — orientation; shrinks to a coral speck at max zoom.
  • Zoom pill + breadcrumb — “3% → 6400%” and Product › Checkout › conversion › 09:42.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Log-space zoom — interpolate log(scale) so perceived speed stays constant; 4–6 s per dive (2–3 bars at 120 BPM), sine.inOut, landing on a downbeat.
  • Level-of-detail cross-fade — dots → cluster labels → chart → number swap at scale thresholds over 0.2 s, each threshold crossed on a beat.
  • Pull-back reveal — expo.out zoom-out over 1.6 s with a teal ripple radiating across the dots, stagger by distance 0.004 s/px.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Why: it proves the agent's coverage physically — it watches everything and still finds one data point — and one continuous move is spectacular and highly readable at 1:1. Risk: text and SVG blur at extreme scale; build it as nested layers you swap at thresholds instead of scaling a single DOM tree, and budget real build time.

Adapt to your product: map your own hierarchy onto the dive (workspace › project › item › field) and let the deepest level be the one value your product catches.
